description: This file contains generated protobuf message classes for the databroker v1 API, including request and reply message schemas for data points, subscriptions, and metadata. It is used for serialization and deserialization of data exchanged between components.

classes.name: GetDatapointsRequest
classes.description: Request message to get specific data points by name.

classes.name: GetDatapointsReply
classes.description: Reply message containing values of requested data points.

classes.name: SubscribeRequest
classes.description: Request message to subscribe to data points or expressions.

classes.name: SubscribeReply
classes.description: Reply message providing subscribed data points and expressions.

classes.name: GetMetadataRequest
classes.description: Request to retrieve metadata for specific data points.

classes.name: GetMetadataReply
classes.description: Reply containing metadata information for data points.
